title: Video Editor – Social Media & Ads Content (AI-Skilled)
description:
**Job Summary**

We're looking for a video editor with a strong eye for social media and performance ad content. You'll be editing short\-form videos for Reels, ads, and campaign content, working from raw footage as well as briefs for AI\-generated video content. This role suits someone fast, detail\-oriented, and comfortable working with daily delivery timelines.

**Responsibilities**

* Edit short\-form videos for social media and paid ad campaigns
* Work from daily briefs to deliver polished edits on a consistent schedule
* Generate and edit AI\-created video content based on provided prompts/references
* Maintain brand consistency across tone, pacing, and visual style
* Communicate progress and deliverables through the team's shared workflow
* Organize and manage video assets following provided naming/storage conventions

**Requirements**

* 0–1 years of experience editing video content, preferably for social media or ad campaigns
* Proficiency in editing software (Filmora, CapCut, or similar)
* Working knowledge of AI video/content generation tools (e.g., Runway, Kling, Sora, or similar)
* Strong understanding of short\-form content pacing, hooks, and platform\-specific formats (Reels, Shorts, ads)
* Ability to meet daily/tight delivery deadlines
* Good communication skills, comfortable working in a structured feedback loop

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with performance\-driven ad creative (not just organic content)
* Basic motion graphics or text animation skills
* Prior experience working with a fixed daily brief/output cadence

Pay: ₹240,000\.00 \- ₹260,000\.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Coimbatore South, Tamil Nadu

title: Junior Digital Marketing Executive
description:
We are looking for a **Junior Digital Marketing Executive** with **1–2 years of experience** to manage and support our digital marketing and e\-commerce activities.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage and monitor **Google Ads campaigns** and track performance.
* Handle **email marketing** campaigns and customer communications.
* Maintain and update the **online store**, including products, pricing, and availability.
* Track **sales, conversions, and marketing performance**.
* Update and monitor **inventory** regularly.
* Use **Google Analytics, Google Ads, Google Tag Manager, Search Console, and other Google tools** for tracking, reporting, and insights.
* Prepare regular performance reports and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Coordinate with the team to improve online sales and overall digital performance.

**Requirements:**

* **1–2 years of experience** in digital marketing/e\-commerce.
* **Any degree**.
* Basic to good knowledge of **Google Ads, Email Marketing, and e\-commerce platforms**.
* Good analytical, communication, and reporting skills.
* Ability to work with data and track KPIs.

Pay: From ₹20,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Experience:

* Digital marketing: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person
